classification: oracle-only truth/conditional compilation and runtime observations before source admission
findings: Ordinary constant-left short-circuit compilation may skip the right operand; array prepass visits both operands first.
Ordinary ternary compiles both arms, while array prepass selects a single arm for constant conditions, including nonconstant selected children.
Selected-child replacement preserves delayed CV/reference reads; ordinary ternary value-copy observes the selected operand earlier.
Global NAN truth warnings differ in phase/count among operators and prepass versus ordinary compilation; namespace fallback stays late.
Nested ternary grouping errors belong to ordinary conditional compilation and can be erased by prior folding/skipping.
limitations: These are raw pinned oracle observations, not source semantic passes.
No intentional engine divergence or inventory closure is introduced.
